m1-split-scheme.title: Build + test the generalized deterministic split-scheme (rotating-block, K=n/2 partitions)
m1-split-scheme.imperative: In scripts/run_season_panel_670.py implement enumerate_rotating_half_partitions(circuits): sort circuits into a fixed canonical (alphabetical) order c_0..c_{n-1} (n even, balanced); for k=0..(n/2 - 1) build half_a(k) = the n/2 circuits at contiguous positions [k..k+n/2-1] mod n (wrap-around window), half_b(k) = the complement -- yielding K=n/2 distinct balanced partitions, deterministic and seed-free (no random/seed anywhere). Write tests/unit/physics/instrument_panel/test_panel_corpus.py with tests proving: (a) two independent calls on the same circuit list produce byte-identical partitions (determinism); (b) every partition splits the circuits into two EQUAL-size halves whose union is the full circuit set and whose intersection is empty (balance); (c) K == n/2 distinct partitions are produced on a >=6-circuit synthetic list; (d) grep-style structural check that the function contains no `random`/`seed` usage. Run the new test file; it must pass.

postconditions.statement: test_panel_corpus.py split-scheme tests pass (determinism + balance + K=n/2 + no-random)

constraints: no random/seed; deterministic construction only; do not edit src/physics/instrument_panel/*
